segments.name: OEM Appliance and Large Data Center
segments.description: Rack-scale AI server solutions for hyperscaler CSPs and sovereign AI projects. Includes GPU-optimized servers, liquid-cooled racks, and complete AI infrastructure.
segments.note: Management targeting 6-8 large datacenter customers in FY2026 (up from 4 in FY2025)

segments.name: Enterprise / Channel
segments.description: Enterprise IT server solutions sold through distributors, VARs, system integrators, and direct sales.

q2_fy2026.note: Record quarter. Includes ~$1.5B delayed Q1 shipments. Beat guidance ($10-11B). AI GPU platforms >90% of revenue.

fy2026_guidance.note: Raised from $33B to $40B after Q2 beat. Original target was $36B at start of fiscal year.

gross_margin_trend.drivers: Competitive pricing pressure from Dell/HPE, rising GPU component costs, product/customer mix shift toward large hyperscalers with lower margins, price war dynamics
gross_margin_trend.source: Multiple quarterly earnings releases + Simply Wall St analysis

geographic_breakdown.note: Largest market. Hyperscaler and enterprise concentration.
Strong growth driven by Thailand, Japan. Sovereign AI demand.
Fastest growing region. UK, Sweden, Spain driving growth. 30+ Blackwell enterprise AI products launched for European market.

key_suppliers.name: NVIDIA
key_suppliers.role: GPU supplier (H100, H200, B200, GB200 NVL72)
key_suppliers.risk: Critical single-supplier dependency. NVIDIA rerouted some SMCI orders to other suppliers in late 2024 during accounting crisis. Allocation tier may have been affected.

key_customers.description: 4 large datacenter / hyperscaler customers in FY2025, targeting 6-8 in FY2026
key_customers.note: Customer names undisclosed. Likely includes major CSPs (Meta, Microsoft, etc.). Customer base becoming more concentrated as company targets larger deals.

supply_chain.concentration_risk: Extreme supplier concentration: NVIDIA alone = 64.4% of purchases. Customer concentration increasing as business shifts toward fewer, larger hyperscaler accounts. Both supply and demand side carry significant concentration risk.

tam.sources: GM Insights ($128B/28.2% CAGR), MarketsandMarkets, Grand View Research ($854B by 2030), TrendForce (28% YoY shipment growth), Bloomberg ($252B total server market)

technology_leadership.dlc_production_capacity: 6,000 racks/month total, ~3,000 DLC (45% liquid-cooled ratio, highest in industry)
technology_leadership.dlc_2_specs: Handles up to 120kW per rack, reduces data center power by 40%, lowers TCO by 20%
technology_leadership.building_block_architecture: Modular design enables new GPU-compatible server in <6 weeks vs months for Dell/HPE
technology_leadership.note: AI GPU platforms represent >90% of Q2 FY2026 revenue

manufacturing.us_manufacturing: Expanding US-based manufacturing for government/compliance applications

governance_history.accounting_crisis: Late 2024 auditor resignation (Ernst & Young), near-delisting from NASDAQ. BDO LLP appointed as new auditor. Filed delayed 10-K in Feb 2025.
governance_history.impact: NVIDIA temporarily rerouted orders; some customers shifted to Dell/HPE; stock declined significantly
governance_history.resolution: Maintained NASDAQ listing, filed overdue reports, regained some customer confidence
